AI = 200 × (I(p) − I(p′)) / (I(p) + I(p′)), smoothed by normalised convolution within the brain (FWHM 10 mm by default: absorbs the residual anatomical asymmetry of the affine registration), restricted to grey matter (cortex and nuclei of the parcellation, both sides), then robust z over the patient’s AI distribution (median, MAD). Kept: |z| ≥ threshold and |AI| ≥ minimum; cold = voxel with lower uptake than its homologue. Avoids two biases of the region method: dilution of a focus within a large region and a cortex / white matter mix that differs between left and right.
